reconcile.note: The Geneva Bible's annotators hold that Satan's dominion over the world is real but only permitted and non-absolute, so his offer does not rival God's outright ownership.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Thomas Paine catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Thomas Paine, The Age of Reason (1794).

sides.snippet: for all the earth is mine;
sides.verseText: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice, and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;

sides.snippet: I will give you all this authority, and their glory, for it has been delivered to me; and I give it to whomever I want.
sides.verseText: The devil said to him, \"I will give you all this authority, and their glory, for it has been delivered to me; and I give it to whomever I want.
